sources.citation: RAVEL authored premises and conventions; license: Apache-2.0. External primary references are locator-only in each registry row.

nodes.statement: For exclusion without a prescribed statistic RAVEL uses 95% CLs. A prescribed statistic, confidence region or credible interval remains the primary requested quantity. CLs is a modified frequentist ratio of tail probabilities; it is not a discovery p-value or Bayesian probability.
nodes.applicability: Review this convention in the stated process, observable, phase-space domain and perturbative order; retrieval does not establish applicability.

evidence.locator: RAVEL authored convention conv:statistic-policy; primary references: J. Phys. G 28 (2002) 2693; doi:10.1088/0954-3899/28/10/313; Phys. Rev. D 110, 030001; review Statistics, confidence intervals and hypothesis tests

obligations.description: Record the test statistic, tail conventions, nuisance treatment and requested confidence level; distinguish CLs from CLs+b and discovery significance.

nodes.statement: An Asimov data set represents an expected-data construction at a specified parameter point. Profile-likelihood asymptotic formulae rely on regularity and adequate information; parameter boundaries, sparse counts and non-identifiability can require calibration.
nodes.applicability: Review this convention in the stated process, observable, phase-space domain and perturbative order; retrieval does not establish applicability.

evidence.locator: RAVEL authored convention conv:asimov-profile; primary references: arXiv:1007.1727, sections 2-4; Phys. Rev. D 110, 030001; review Statistics, confidence intervals and hypothesis tests

obligations.description: State observed versus expected data, the Asimov truth, nuisance constraints and parameter boundaries; test coverage or calibration when asymptotic assumptions fail.

nodes.statement: Discovery tests the background-only hypothesis. A local discovery significance and a global significance after searching a parameter range differ. An exclusion contour is not a discovery claim.
nodes.applicability: Review this convention in the stated process, observable, phase-space domain and perturbative order; retrieval does not establish applicability.

evidence.locator: RAVEL authored convention conv:discovery; primary references: arXiv:1007.1727, sections 2-4; Phys. Rev. D 110, 030001; review Statistics, confidence intervals and hypothesis tests

obligations.description: Declare the discovery null, test statistic, local or global scope and treatment of the search population.
